label: Denver Restaurants
description: 40 Denver eats — from tasting-menu temples to Casa Bonita.

items.name: Tavernetta
items.note: The Frasca team's Denver Italian. Impeccable, from the bread to the amaro.

items.name: Sushi Den
items.note: Fish flown in from Nagahama. Denver's most beloved sushi, full stop.

items.name: Mizuna
items.note: Frank Bonanno's flagship. The lobster mac is a rite of passage.

items.name: Barolo Grill
items.note: The staff takes an annual trip to Italy. It shows.

items.name: The Fort
items.note: Bison, elk, and rattlesnake in an adobe fort near Red Rocks. Peak Colorado.

items.name: El Taco de Mexico
items.note: A no-frills counter with a James Beard award. The green chile is holy.

items.name: Snooze, an A.M. Eatery
items.note: Denver-born and worth the inevitable 45-minute wait. Get the pancake flight.

items.name: Little Man Ice Cream
items.note: The 28-foot cream can you've seen on every Denver postcard.

items.name: Rioja
items.note: Jennifer Jasinski's Larimer Square gem.

items.name: Cart-Driver
items.note: Wood-fired pizza and oysters out of a shipping container.

items.name: Safta
items.note: The hummus and fresh laffa alone justify the trip.

items.name: Illegal Pete's
items.note: Denver's own burrito answer to the big chain. Free chips policy respected.

items.name: Sam's No. 3
items.note: A sprawling downtown diner with a menu the length of a phone book.

items.name: Pete's Kitchen
items.note: The 2am Colfax gyro that has ended more nights than it should.

items.name: Torchy's Tacos
items.note: Damn Good tacos, per the slogan, per the fierce debate that follows.

items.name: Buckhorn Exchange
items.note: Denver's oldest restaurant, Liquor License No. 1, and a lot of taxidermy watching you eat elk.

items.name: City, O' City
items.note: Vegetarian comfort food and a Cap Hill hangout at all hours.

items.name: The Cherry Cricket
items.note: Everyone's 'best burger in Denver' pick, which is exactly why it's a fight.

items.name: Casa Bonita
items.note: Cliff divers, sopapillas, a fake volcano, and the worst-best food in Colorado. A perfect chaos pick.

items.name: Downtown Aquarium
items.note: You eat fish while other fish watch. It's a whole thing.

items.name: Hard Rock Cafe Denver
items.note: Guitars on the wall, mid nachos, a t-shirt you'll regret buying.

items.name: Beau Jo's Pizza
items.note: Mountain Pies with a crust so thick they give you honey to eat it like dessert.

items.name: Voodoo Doughnut
items.note: A doughnut the size of your face at 3am. The line is somehow always there.

items.name: Wynkoop Brewing Company
items.note: Colorado's first brewpub, co-founded by a guy who became governor. The food is... fine.
